 Follow Hailey Bieber drops navy blue Rhode collection for 30th birthday
 Saman Shafiq, USA TODAY Updated Mon, November 16, 2026 at 5:15 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Hailey Bieber is entering a new decade and is celebrating with a new Rhode collection .
 For her 30th birthday, the Rhode founder and model is launching a "limited-edition navy capsule," which includes the brand's first-ever matte blush, new variations of Rhode's beloved Peptide Lip Boost and wearable merchandise, along other things.
 "The collection brings together Hailey's go-to Rhode staples alongside exclusive new pieces for birthday plans and travel days ahead," Rhode said in a Nov. 16 news release.
 Advertisement Advertisement The capsule marks Rhode's fifth consecutive collection celebrating Bieber's birthday , "a tradition that has become a meaningful way for Hailey to celebrate with the Rhode community that has been there every step of the way," Rhode said.

 The navy capsule collection includes:
 Pocket Plush ($16): The new matte blush in a limited-edition mini navy stick come in two shades, Baldwin (Berry Rose) and Tucson (Rich Burgundy), both created by Bieber. She recommends wearing her favorite shade, Baldwin, on the cheeks and lips for a soft matte monochromatic look.
 Peptide Lip Boost ($23): A limited-edition version of the beloved plumping lip mask in a shimmery sheer pink with a cherry vanilla cola scent.
 Peptide Eye Prep ($25): Rhode's classic depuffing patches in two birthday exclusive navy styles: r icon + heart eyes.
 Reversible Windbreaker ($148): An oversized jacket − navy nylon on one side and grey fleece on the other − inspired by Hailey's love of vintage sportswear.
 Carry Case ($38): A navy structured travel pouch for packing your travel essentials.
 Snap-On Lip Case in Navy ($46): A birthday special to house the Peptide Lip Treatment or tint so it's always on hand.
 The Birthday Set ($55): The limited-edition set includes lip and cheek staples − both shades of Pocket Plush and Peptide Lip Boost in Cherry Vanilla Cola − from Hailey's 30th birthday capsule.
 When will Hailey's 30th birthday rhode collection be available?
 Bieber's 30th birthday collection will be available to purchase exclusively at rhodeskin.com starting 12 p.m. ET / 9 a.m. PT on Nov. 20, two days before she blows her birthday candles on Nov. 22.
 Advertisement Advertisement The reversible windbreaker, however, will only be available for pre-order on Nov. 20.
 Shop the full collection 
 Hailey Bieber kicks off birthday celebrations
 Bieber, meanwhile, kicked off her birthday celebrations early blowing candles with husband Justin Bieber and close friend Kendall Jenner among others, Elle reported .
 Rhode co-founder and president Lauren Ratner posted photos from the birthday celebrations for which Bieber donned an archival Dolce & Gabbana red-and-black python-print corset with an exposed black lace bra and mesh trim, according to Marie Claire .
 In the pictures, Bieber could be seeing cutting a two-tier pink birthday cake decorated with cherries, likely a nod to the upcoming collection's cherry vanilla cola scent.
